u.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.uid = u.uuid AND ur.role_id IN (1000, 1001) )
AND u.uuid in
#{uid}
ORDER BY ac DESC,total ASC

SELECT u.uuid as uid,u.nickname,u.username,u.avatar,u.email,u.title_name,u.title_color, (SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT pid ) FROM user_acproblem WHERE uid =u.uuid and DATE(gmt_create) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS ac FROM user_info u WHERE u.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.uid = u.uuid AND ur.role_id IN (1000, 1001) ) ORDER BY ac DESC,u.gmt_create DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ui.uuid AS uid, ui.nickname, ui.username, left(ui.signature,100) as signature, ui.avatar, ui.email, ui.title_name,ui.title_color , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) FROM user_acproblem WHERE uid = ui.uuid ) AS ac , ( SELECT COUNT(uid) FROM judge WHERE uid = ui.uuid ) AS total, ss.score AS score FROM user_info ui, ( SELECT u.uuid AS uid, COALESCE(SUM(s.score),0) AS score FROM user_info u left join ( SELECT MAX(oi_rank_score) AS score, uid, pid FROM judge WHERE cid=0 GROUP BY pid, uid ) s ON s.uid = u.uuid WHERE u.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.uid = u.uuid AND ur.role_id IN (1000, 1001) ) GROUP BY u.uuid ) ss
ss.uid = ui.uuid AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.uid = ui.uuid AND ur.role_id IN (1000, 1001) )
AND ui.uuid in
#{uid}
ORDER BY score DESC, ac DESC
SELECT MAX(oi_rank_score) AS sum_score FROM judge WHERE uid=#{uid} AND cid=0 AND score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pid
